errors.description: descriptor_q is a multi-bit value produced in cfg_clk and sampled directly in dma_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
kick_pulse_q is a one-cycle cfg_clk pulse consumed directly in dma_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
kick_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample dma_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in dma_event_o.
channel_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector channel_q before decoding in dma_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
cfg_rst_n is used as data inside dma_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
mem_snapshot_q combines cfg_clk payload state with dma_clk status state in mem_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
